question: If 3 May 2010 is a Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 16 December 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is** ****Tuesday.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The number of odd days from 3 May 2010 to 16 December 2014 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2010
 3 May 2010 - 31 December 2010
 365 days - 31 January - 28 February - 31 March - 30 April - 3 May = 242 days
 242 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2011 - 2013
 Full year (2 Ordinary years + 1 Leap year)
 (1 × 2) + (2 × 1) = 4
 4
 
 

 2014
 1st January 2014 - 16 December 2014
 365 days - 15 days = 350
 350 ÷ 7 = 0
 
 

 Total odd days
 (8 ÷ 7) = **1**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 3 May 2010 to 16 December 2014 ⇒ 1

⇒So, One odd day get added to Monday because day asked in future.

∴ The day of the week on the 16 December 2014 is Tuesday.
